lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run reversals against strong 4h/Daily trends, leading to premature entries during distribution or accumulation phases. By prioritizing local liquidity sweeps over the dominant trend, the strategy is getting trapped in 'fakeouts' that fail to initiate a structural shift.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend Alignment Filter' that mandates a 4h market structure break in the direction of the trade before allowing any entry on lower timeframes.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less when they contradict the 4h/Daily Wyckoff trend.
